findings.evidence: The form includes #name-input (Full name), #legalname-input (Your name), #phone2-input (Secondary phone, optional), #website-input (Company website), #member-input (Membership number), #acctnum-input (Account number), #shipspeed-select (Preferred shipping speed), #contacttime-input (Preferred contact time), and #hear-select (How did you hear about us?).
findings.fix: Remove duplicate name field. Make phone number optional or defer to later. Move Company website, Membership number, Account number, Preferred shipping speed, Preferred contact time, and How did you hear about us? to a later step or optional section, keeping only fields required for account creation: name, email, password.
findings.violation: The form asks for the person's name twice: once as Full name (#name-input) and again as Your name (#legalname-input), and includes many fields that serve shipping, marketing or later steps rather than account creation.

findings.violation: The select offers Other as an option but provides no way for the person to specify what they meant, making the choice unusable.

findings.evidence: <button id="viewdetails-btn" type="button" style="padding:12px 20px;font-size:16px">View details</button> appears at line 81, between the #contacttime-input field (line 79) and #hear-select (line 84), while #submit-btn (primary) appears at line 92 after all fields.
findings.fix: Move the View details button to the end of the form, after the submit button or clearly mark it as secondary with reduced visual prominence, so the form's primary action is where the fields end.
